summary: Implementation plan for EMSCPS - ລະບົບນຳສົ່ງຄົນເຈັບ ໂຮງໝໍແຂວງຈຳປາສັກ (Champasak Provincial Hospital Referral System) featuring Turso integration with local storage fallback, 5-step mobile-responsive referral submission form with auto-GCS calculation, admin dashboard with analytics and CSV/PDF export, hospital management, and Noto Sans Lao typography.
